source: SEC EDGAR Form N-PORT, Vanguard World Fund: Vanguard ESG U.S. Stock ETF schedule of investments
method: A company listed in the schedule passed the ESGV index screens; absence means excluded (the filing does not state the reason). Non-US companies are outside ESGV's universe.
screen_description: ESGV tracks the FTSE US All Cap Choice Index, which excludes companies involved in e.g. fossil fuels, weapons, tobacco, alcohol, gambling, adult content, nuclear power, and companies failing controversy/diversity criteria (issuer methodology).
